title: Acquitted world junior player Alex Formenton signs one-year deal with Edmonton Oilers
desc: The Edmonton Oilers have signed forward Alex Formenton to a one-year contract worth $850,000 US.

title: Widespread Turbulence is Upsetting Star Formation in Stephan's Quintet
desc: Stephan's Quintet contains the most well-studied compact galaxy group. Japanese researchers have mapped star forming gas in the Quintet, along with its turbulence. The results show that the Quintet is an evolved group of interacting galaxies where gas struggles to settle down and form stars. Even where gas is concentrated, turbulence from interactions throttles star formation.

title: Ghana VP urges West African Catholic youth to build peace
desc: Ghana’s Vice President Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang called on Catholic youth in West Africa to help build peace, expand opportunities and use digital platforms responsibly.

title: ACC Latin America 2026 brings together experts to examine the latest cardiovascular science

title: 'No concern' over air, water quality from Summerside solar farm fire, say city and CPHO
desc: The fire situation at Summerside's Sunbank solar farm is showing signs of improvement, with wind conditions trending in a positive direction, the city said in a news release Wednesday at noon.

title: 'Unhinged' for Canada to call dispute with U.S. a trade war, says Trump's tariff chief
desc: U.S. President Donald Trump's top trade official says it's "unhinged" for Canadian leaders to characterize the administration's tariffs as a trade war against Canada.

title: Multiple Chinese hacking groups seen using identical Chrome zero-day exploit
